projects.name: Kathaa 360
projects.problem: Two vital traditions have faded: bedtime stories that teach morals and reflection, and the traditional folk tales once told aloud on neighbourhood streets that passed down local culture. Endless scrolling leaves people disconnected from their roots, while many online retellings rely on Western or British colonial sources rather than truthful indigenous records.
projects.audience: Children, families, students and busy adults who want one focused hour of spoken bedtime stories, street folk tales and moral education, with a private journal for ideas and thoughts as they listen.
projects.today: A live spoken-storytelling web app with The 12 Jyotirlingas (first 3 chapters, clearly marked as AI-assisted Sanskrit and English drafts awaiting human Sanskrit scholar review), spoken narration, a built-in private browser journal, and a strict 60-minute daily limit.
projects.future: Why one hour a day? Because we do not want to take much of your time, and one hour of daily knowledge starts like a seed that grows into a wisdom plant for the future. Ahead: street folk tales, regional legends, moral fables, family accounts, and narration in familiar voices with recorded consent.

projects.name: Dish (What Do I Cook Today?)
projects.problem: Bachelors, students, and solo-living people who enjoy food often find recipe sites written for stocked family pantries, with little guidance on pan heat, zero-oil substitutions, or regional allergen rules.
projects.audience: Bachelors, solo households, and kitchen beginners cooking from whatever is already in the fridge, plus curious learners trying small-batch weekly mystery-ingredient challenges.
projects.today: A live web app at dish.athi360.uk: tap or type the ingredients you have (including Hinglish like jeera, tamatar, aloo, tel) to match across 1,277 safety-gated recipes (17 hand-written solo staples plus 1,260 AI-drafted recipes machine-checked for doneness cues, raw-meat hygiene, and UK/EU/US/India allergens, each clearly marked as not yet human-reviewed), with no-oil variants, stove-knob heat guidance, 5 interactive 3D WebGL cooking physics scenes, and a Monday 5-ingredient Chef's Challenge.
projects.future: Human culinary testing across the AI-drafted recipe library, verified household food-hygiene sources for India and EU registers, and community-rated weekly solo cooking experiments.

projects.name: Circuit Lab 360
projects.problem: Standard electronics teaching tells you that a circuit failed without showing why unless you damage real parts. On expensive equipment the risk discourages experimentation, while makers testing component changes and researchers planning layouts inside confined enclosures lack a verifiable browser lab.
projects.audience: Makers and engineers testing upgrades to specific electrical components, beginners and students who want clear explanations of why circuits fail, and researchers planning component placement inside confined systems.
projects.today: A live parametric CAD and SPICE simulation studio at circuit-lab.athi360.uk powered by real ngspice WebAssembly in the browser, with 24 verified packs, AC Bode sweeps, 103 engine solver tests and 1,197 unit tests, a 6-variant C9 ablation engine, and a live AI Explain, Fix, and Tutor drawer on Azure AI Foundry (DeepSeek-V4) behind a global daily spend cap.
projects.future: Simulating component upgrades and where they perform best, planning component placement inside confined systems for researchers, and finding leaner, higher-efficiency circuits verified by a real SPICE solver.

projects.name: Hrushimanju
projects.problem: Most people own plenty of clothes they rarely combine well because nobody shows how lightness contrast, undertone hue gap, and silhouette balance work together, while commercial styling apps push new purchases or output rigid single-photo seasonal labels that flip whenever room lighting changes.
projects.audience: Adults (18+) who want an analytical way to compare outfits using the wardrobe they already own, alongside cosplayers and self-taught fashion learners studying colour geometry and proportion.
projects.today: A live 18+ static garment-only showcase at hrushimanju.uk: compares Look A against Look B in browser RAM using 3D CIELAB colour geometry, four-illuminant Bradford chromatic adaptation (6500K to 2700K), nine structural outfit rules, and manual non-ranked Shade Twin reference swatches (with zero face-photo uploads while formal DPIA and age-assurance review is in progress, and zero server calls).
projects.future: Completing external DPIA and age-assurance sign-off, controlled-capture colour calibration kits for cosplayers, and custom outfit prototyping.

projects.name: ConsumerSuit
projects.problem: Ordinary people facing a consumer, tenancy, or workplace dispute often cannot afford a solicitor and struggle to work out which statute sections or time limits apply to their facts before critical deadlines expire.
projects.audience: Everyday citizens in England and Wales (tenants, consumers, and employees, including people whose first language is not English) organising their own dispute timeline, evidence, and correspondence as litigants in person.
projects.today: A live self-help legal information web app in public beta (not legal advice and not a law firm) covering 63 statutes across 8 areas of England and Wales civil and employment law. It structures scattered notes and documents into a chronological timeline, checks statutory deadlines, fetches live statute sections from legislation.gov.uk, and publishes open accuracy scorecards at consumer-suit.uk/beta.html.
projects.future: Solicitor-reviewed pilot evaluations with university law clinics and advice bodies, tighter multi-run section determinism, and structured summaries designed to help advisers and tribunal panels read litigant-in-person bundles faster.

projects.name: Astral Nexus
projects.problem: World cultures built deep mathematical and symbolic traditions to read the sky, the palm and dreams—yet modern astrology apps scatter and flatten them into generic, ad-ridden pop horoscopes that never show how different traditions interpret the same blueprint.
projects.audience: Curious explorers and pattern-seekers who want to enter their birth details, palm readings or dream symbols and see how different cultural systems and traditions interpret them side by side, alongside scholars working with historical manuscripts.
projects.today: A live multi-tradition platform at astralnexus.athi360.uk across 7 languages: calculates your birth chart (Lagna, Moon sign, rising sign, nakshatras and dashas) on your own device with a real open-source ephemeris, alongside cross-cultural reading traditions, card decks and dream dossiers backed by 530+ researched sources.
projects.future: Expanded palmistry (Hastarekha) and comparative cultural reading modules, place-aware sky tools, and a cited archive of ancient palm leaves and historical texts.
